critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1178 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. The new /api/public/* router should live in routers/public_portal.py; /api/search in routers/search.py; and models can be split into schemas/*.py.

GET /api/approvals silently backfills public_token on read. That's a write-on-read side effect that (a) violates REST semantics (GET should be idempotent, not mutating), and (b) means clients can never share a token before someone calls /api/approvals first. Preferred: backfill once during seed / startup migration, or lazily generate on first /api/public/approvals/{id} lookup keyed by approval id.

public_token is only uuid4().hex[:20] — 80 bits of entropy is fine, but there's no expiration, no revocation and no rate-limit. Anyone who ever received the link can approve/revise forever. Consider adding expires_at + optional one-time-use or per-decision nonce.

POST /api/public/approvals/{token}/decide accepts 'approve' after the approval is already 'approved' — status is overwritten silently. Should return 409 or a no-op message so a stale link can't flip an approved decision.

GET /api/search regex compiles user input directly ({"$regex": q}) — a client sending a pathological regex like '(a+)+$' can DoS Mongo. Escape q with re.escape() before feeding to $regex, or use $text with a text index.

GET /api/search returns approval preview only via title/preview match. Client name (via join) is not searchable; e.g. searching 'Galalite' will not surface approvals whose title doesn't contain the client name. Consider denormalising client name onto approvals or doing a two-stage lookup.

POST /api/jobs/{id}/comments uses _apply_role_filter — a manager mentioning a team member on a job the manager isn't assigned to still works (manager is admin, filter is no-op), but a team member mentioning someone on a job they aren't assigned to gets a 404 first. Behaviour is correct but silently drops the mention.

Mention parsing on the frontend (JobDetailModal.jsx pickMention) matches by first-name prefix case-insensitively; two users sharing a first name (e.g. two Priyas) would both be inserted as '@Priya ' and both get notified — no disambiguation UI.

PublicApproval.jsx imports AttachmentPreview and JobDetailModal.jsx re-imports it from the public page — circular-ish coupling between a public route and an internal component. Extract AttachmentPreview into components/AttachmentPreview.jsx.
GlobalSearch dropdown closes on input blur with a 200ms delay hack. If the user tabs (keyboard) to a result, blur fires before Enter — accessibility issue. Prefer explicit outside-click handler.

The public portal exposes job.desc via PublicApproval — for internal jobs whose desc contains sensitive info (e.g. margin numbers), this leaks to the client. Project only preview/deliverable-safe fields.

Public /decide endpoint sets decided_by_client from client-supplied author with only a .strip() — no length cap or HTML escape. If someone posts <script>… it renders as raw text via React (safe by default), but stored data is unbounded (could be 1MB).
